content.description: It combines everyday content with controlled stress cases so we can verify stability, continuation behavior, text fitting, image replacement, and table rendering in one run.

content.left_text: In the first column, we summarize the situation, constraints, and assumptions that shape the project scope. This helps align teams before execution and avoids ambiguity when trade-offs appear.
content.right_text: In the second column, we outline the practical path forward, including dependencies, milestones, and review checkpoints. Keeping this narrative side by side makes complex context easier to scan quickly.
